reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, parent_category, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, SUM(units * unit_cost_eur) - SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS loss_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL AND units IS NOT NULL AND unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_id, product_name, parent_category
HAVING SUM(units * unit_cost_eur) > SUM(net_revenue_eur)
ORDER BY parent_category, product_id

       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       SUM(units * unit_cost_eur) - SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS loss_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL AND units IS NOT NULL AND unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_id, product_name, parent_category
